ITEM 1 | Bright red-pink cubes about 1.5-2 cm, moist and glossy, with a juicy surface and clean cut edges. Clustered in the upper-left of the plate, footprint about 8% of the plate, roughly 1.5 cm tall. | 60
ITEM 2 | Opaque white, soft, slightly crumbly cubes and chunks with irregular edges, matte surface, mounded across the center and right of the plate. Footprint about 35-40% of the plate, roughly 2 cm tall. | 120
ITEM 3 | Olive-green chunky sauce with visible seeds and flecks, glossy and thick, mounded on top of the white pieces in the center. Footprint about 10% of the plate, roughly 1.5 cm tall. | 50
ITEM 4 | Two golden-brown rectangular halves with a square grid pattern of indentations on the top, crisp-looking edges, and a slightly matte surface. Placed side by side at the bottom of the plate, together covering about 15% of the plate, roughly 1.5 cm thick. | 90
